For the current staging handoff only: GO if the staging slot is ready, otherwise HOLD. Staging slot is ready.
Patch: cache-patch. Earlier development used v1 at East. Later signed scope below supersedes proposals; permission does not transfer across versions or sites.
Signed exception: recorded; version=v11; site=Harbor. This is the entire permitted scope; unknown means scope evidence unavailable.
Passing checks: two reports; acquisition_ids=A,B; outcomes=passed,passed. Equal acquisition IDs mean reused evidence, not independent checks; unknown means independence unresolved.
Rollback evidence: tested_site=Harbor. This is the complete tested-site list; unknown means the coverage record is unavailable. A tested site does not establish coverage elsewhere.
The latency limit was corrected from80 to120ms. A100ms read-only probe passed; no write-path result is recorded.
A post-release monitor is proposed, not started. Preserve scoped permissions and evidence qualifications for the next colleague.
